args.question: For pair_A, the threshold table varies mount_l_cm while all other geometry is fixed. Which end of the coupling spring does mount_l_cm describe: the attachment distance on the rotor whose threshold is being measured, on the other (clamped) rotor, or both symmetrically? Is the coupling spring's other end at a fixed attachment distance, and is the same physical spring used at all four mount_l_cm values?
